svg.title: M107 — Sparse XOR-tail / delta / Bloom variants / enhanced thematic plate
svg.desc: Change the recurrence using XOR tails, deltas or Bloom-filter-assisted membership screening and compare its generated values with targets. Original finding: Alternate sparse generative families were tested without establishing a transferable key-generation rule.
svg.text: Change the recurrence using XOR tails, deltas or
compare its generated values with targets.
These are alternative sparse candidate recipes. A Bloom hit is only a screening event; the scalar still needs
exact address verification, and saved summaries do not establish a transferable generator.
Alternate sparse generative families were tested without establishing a transferable key-generation rule.
